headline: Jefferson's first win ends a run of six defeats
dek: Jefferson had lost every match they played this season before the visitors arrived. One win now sits beside six defeats, and no draw, in a record that until last night held nothing but losses.
displaced_by: results night: Jefferson's first win of the season after six straight defeats
